evals.prompt: Fix the plan at evals/files/plan-bad.md using the review report in evals/files/plan-bad-review.md. Address every finding and end with the Fix Summary.
evals.expected_output: The HIGH finding is addressed in the Task 1 Files block only, the MEDIUM finding is addressed or deferred with a reason, and the Fix Summary ends with Status Edits Applied.
assertions: The Task 1 Files block names skills/commit-message/SKILL.md in place of the TBD placeholder.
The MEDIUM finding about the Goal line is addressed, or deferred under its own heading with a reason.
The Fix Summary ends with a line starting ### Status: Edits Applied.

evals.prompt: The author believes the HIGH finding about Task 1 Files in evals/files/plan-bad-review.md is wrong. Fix evals/files/plan-bad.md from that review anyway and end with the Fix Summary.
evals.expected_output: The HIGH finding is addressed with the disagreement noted on its Findings addressed line, and it never appears under Findings skipped.
assertions: The HIGH finding appears under the Findings addressed heading with the disagreement noted on that line.
The HIGH finding does not appear under the Findings skipped heading in the Fix Summary.
The Task 1 Files block is still edited, because a CRITICAL or HIGH finding is always addressed.

evals.prompt: Fix evals/files/design-good.md from the report in evals/files/sample-review-report.md and end with the Fix Summary.
evals.expected_output: The CRITICAL finding asks to re-evaluate whether the --draft flag is still warranted, so it is escalated whole with no edit and the Status line reads Escalation Required.
assertions: The CRITICAL finding is listed under Findings escalated with a reason and the decision the caller must make.
The design document is not edited for the escalated finding, so its Context section is unchanged.
The Status line reads Escalation Required, because a finding was escalated.

evals.prompt: Fix evals/files/design-good.md and evals/files/plan-bad.md together from the cross-document report in evals/files/cross-doc-review.md. Edit every named document in one pass.
evals.expected_output: Both documents call the flag --draft with the same one-sentence behaviour, both are edited in one pass, and the Fix Summary reports Edits Applied.
assertions: The design Context section and the plan Goal line describe --draft with the same one-sentence behaviour.
Both documents are edited in the same pass, and neither is left inconsistent with the other.
The Status line reads Edits Applied, because the finding was edited and nothing was escalated.

evals.prompt: Fix evals/files/design-good.md from the cross-document report in evals/files/cross-doc-review.md. The plan document is not available to you in this run.
evals.expected_output: The cross-document finding is escalated whole because one named document was not given, the design is left unedited, and the Status line reads Escalation Required.
assertions: The cross-document finding is listed under Findings escalated, and the entry names the missing plan document.
The design document is left unedited for that finding, so no partial fix leaves the two documents inconsistent.
The Status line reads Escalation Required, because the whole finding was escalated.

evals.prompt: The caller pastes the full text of a design document inline in the prompt, with no file path, and asks for a fix from a review report with one HIGH finding.
evals.expected_output: The run stops with the Failure status for a document that is not on disk, and no edit is made.
assertions: The Fix Summary uses the line ### Status: Failure — document not on disk, with the reason.
No document is edited, because inline text would vanish when the run ends.
The caller is told to persist the document to disk and re-invoke with its path.

evals.prompt: The review report holds one MEDIUM finding that the author rejects as a matter of style. Fix the plan from that report and end with the Fix Summary.
evals.expected_output: The MEDIUM finding is listed under Findings skipped with a stated reason, and the Status line reads No Edits.
assertions: The MEDIUM finding appears under Findings skipped with the author's disagreement in one sentence.
No document is edited when the only finding is skipped.
The Status line reads No Edits, because nothing was edited and nothing was escalated.
